bio.text: Trent Kelly has represented Mississippi's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House since winning a special election runoff on June 2, 2015.
He previously served as District Attorney for Mississippi's 1st Circuit Judicial District and was Tupelo city prosecutor.
Kelly served 39 years in the Mississippi Army National Guard, retiring in April 2025 as a Major General, including deployments to Iraq.
He has a law degree from the University of Mississippi and lives in Saltillo.
